seo.description: Every patient is equal. Every patient is heard. Since 1971, Indira Gandhi Co-operative Hospital (IGCH), Kadavanthra, Kochi, has offered equal respect for everyone and extra support for those who need it most.

head.heading: Where it began: a peoples hospital since 1971

paragraphs: In 1971, the people of Kochi came together to build a hospital they could all rely on, whatever their means. Founded by the Cochin Co-operative Hospitals Society, Indira Gandhi Co-operative Hospital (IGCH), Kadavanthra, Kochi, has grown into an affordable multispeciality co-operative hospital in Kochi, with 30 medical departments. More than fifty years later, it continues to follow the same belief: every patient deserves equal respect and quality healthcare, with additional support for those who need it most.

[Founding members, the original building near Ernakulam South Railway Station, the early years and the new hospital complex inaugurated on 17 September 1986 - additional details need to be collected from IGCH.]
Every patient receives the same respect, dignity and commitment to quality care, regardless of their financial circumstances.
We provide additional support to those who need it most through free and subsidised cancer screening, affordable treatment and free dialysis services.

items.quote: Collectively, we are driven by a single overriding goal: to make sure that you, your family, friends and neighbours have access to high-quality, high-value care locally, whenever the need arises.
items.name: M O John
message: Indira Gandhi Co-operative Hospital stands as a pillar of excellence and progress in healthcare. For more than 50 years, our dedicated team of doctors, nurses and staff has been unwavering in its mission to strengthen both our hospital and the community we proudly serve. Today, that commitment is stronger than ever, as we continue to advance and adapt to meet the evolving needs of our patients.
Collectively, we are driven by a single overriding goal: to make sure that you, your family, friends and neighbours have access to high-quality, high-value care locally, whenever the need arises.

As president of this institution, I can attest to the fact that IGCH is a “jewel” of an institution with outstanding depth and breadth of clinical capabilities. Beyond these achievements and milestones, we continue to develop and implement new programs and services to provide you with the very best local care possible. If you haven’t been to IGCH recently, I hope you’ll spend time within this site to learn more about our rapidly expanding array of services and capabilities; there truly is no longer any need to travel out of the city for superior health care.

During this time of rapid healthcare transformation, and as one of the fastest-growing hospitals in all of Cochin, IGCH is proud to be recognised as a leader in the field across the Ernakulam District. We are indeed "so good. So caring. So close", and with your support, we’ll continue to improve IGCH each and every day so we can better serve you, your family and the entire Ernakulam District.

items.quote: The hospital has a vision of becoming an ideal centre for health care for the people around the city and surrounding districts, and not of revenue collection.
items.name: [Name]
message: I have immense pleasure in welcoming you to Indira Gandhi Co-operative Hospital [IGCH], a highly progressive and enterprising hospital pledged to providing quality healthcare with great emphasis on traditional values.

Bearing in mind that health is the only tool that uplifts the standard of society, there is a very wide prospect behind providing healthcare by IGCH, Ernakulam. The hospital has a vision of becoming an ideal centre for health care for the people around the city and surrounding districts, and not of revenue collection.

Our dream is to be considered as a pioneer institution of health services, propagating, popularising medical science. We also have a plan to make the base wider to medical, paramedical, nursing and allied fields, which will help in availing medical treatment and health services at affordable cost to the needy ones. The hospital has already arranged the best infrastructure, experienced doctors & nursing staff, modern tools and methodologies.
I firmly believe that health services should foster confidence, discipline, clarity in thought and decision-making at critical stages, and above all, social responsibility as a life-long process.

IGCH takes pride in providing a caring atmosphere to all its patients just apt for the sick minds to be nurtured. It aims to develop scholarly students with great self-discipline, intense perseverance and a zeal to excel, which are the qualities required to meet the challenges of modern society. The hospital seeks utmost co-operation and support at all times to achieve the high standards set, from well-wishers like you.
